issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> — caused by Emergent dev-tool x-source injection in <select><option>{label}</option></select>; harmless in dev, but to silence the warning consider rendering option text via a wrapper-free template (e.g. {`${slot} ${label}`}). Not a functional bug.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:6035-6041 — _get_aarti_item_or_404 reuses _resolve_item_collections so endpoints work transparently for items in either bhakti_items or content_items. Clean.
server.py:6049-6064 — _stream_file_to_disk caps bytes per-file (25MB audio, 120MB video, 5MB image) and removes partial file on overflow with proper 413. Defensive.

server.py:6155-6160 — video upload pre-deletes old main.* extensions before writing new one — prevents stale .mp4 lingering after a .webm replace. Confirmed by test_upload_video_webm_replaces_extension.
server.py:6256-6261 — overlap check uses cur.start_ms < prev.end_ms after parse, returning a precise 400 with verse number. Spec §1 satisfied. Both API + UI paths surface the message.
server.py:6278-6294 — public GET /lang/{lang}/media has no auth dependency — correct for mobile consumption. Returns empty arrays/null gracefully when bucket is missing.
server.py:5723-5739 — PUT /auth/mobile/settings whitelists fields (preferred_language, name) and validates language against AARTI_VALID_LANGS subset. Good.
BhaktiEditorDrawer.js:230 — aarti-lang-bar conditionally rendered based on activeTab in {fulltext,audio,video,sync} AND mode==aarti — matches spec. Verified end-to-end.

Minor: option labels inside <select> are rendered as JSX expressions which Emergent's dev tooling wraps in <span style=display:contents> — generates a hydration warning but is purely a dev-overlay artifact and does not appear in production builds.
